description_en: Obtains the upload URL and credential of a media stream
description_zh: 获取媒体流上传地址和凭证，并将上传完成的媒体流挂载到指定的MediaId下
kebab_example: aliyun ice create-upload-stream --media-id 000020b48fb04483915d4f2cd8ac0000 --definition HD --file-extension MP4 --hdr-type HDR10 --user-data MessageCallback_:_CallbackURL_:_http://aliyundoc.com_,_Extend_:_localId_:_xxx_,_test_:_www --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateUploadStream

parameters.help_en: The ID of the media asset
parameters.name: media_id

parameters.help_en:
The quality of the media stream. Valid values:

FD: low definition.

LD: standard definition.

SD: high definition.

HD: ultra-high definition.

OD: original quality.

2K: 2K resolution.

4K: 4K resolution.

SQ: standard sound quality.

HQ: high sound quality
parameters.help_zh:
视频流清晰度定义。取值：
FD：流畅。
LD：标清。
SD：高清。
HD：超清
OD：原画。
2K：2K。
4K：4K。
SQ：普通音质。
HQ：高音质
parameters.name: definition

parameters.help_en: The file name extension of the media stream
parameters.name: file_extension

parameters.help_en:
The high dynamic range (HDR) format of the transcoded stream. Valid values:

HDR

HDR10

HLG

DolbyVision

HDRVivid

SDR+



The value is not case-sensitive,

You can leave this parameter empty for non-HDR streams
parameters.help_zh:
转码流HDR类型。取值：
HDR
HDR10
HLG
DolbyVision
HDRVivid
SDR+
大小写不敏感。
非HDR视频该参数为空即可
parameters.name: hdr_type

FileURL.description_en: The Object Storage Service (OSS) URL of the file. The URL does not contain the information used for authentication

MediaId.description_en: The ID of the media asset

UploadAddress.description_en:
The upload URL.

The returned upload URL is a Base64-encoded URL. You must decode the Base64-encoded upload URL before you use an SDK or call an API operation to upload media files. You need to parse UploadAddress only if you use OSS SDK or call an OSS API operation to upload media files
UploadAddress.description_zh:
上传地址。

接口返回的上传地址是Base64加密后的值。调用SDK或API完成媒资上传时需要对其进行Base64解码后再使用。仅OSS原生SDK或OSS API方式上传需要自行解析UploadAddress

UploadAuth.description_en:
The upload credential.

The returned upload credential is a Base64-encoded value. You must decode the Base64-encoded upload URL before you use an SDK or call an API operation to upload media files. You need to parse UploadAuth only if you use OSS SDK or call an OSS API operation to upload media files
UploadAuth.description_zh:
上传凭证。
接口返回的上传凭证是Base64加密后的值。调用SDK或API完成媒资上传时需要对其进行Base64解码后再使用。仅OSS原生SDK或OSS API方式上传需要自行解析UploadAuth
